# Grocery Flywheel

> Free, open-source, local-first personal tool that ends grocery decision
> fatigue. Python, stdlib-only, offline. Analyze replenishment, evaluate
> dietary safety against evidence, rank substitutions by objective, draft a
> next cart that always requires human approval. Never places orders.

## Quick start
- README: https://github.com/simongonzalezdc/grocery-flywheel
- Install: pipx install git+https://github.com/simongonzalezdc/grocery-flywheel
- Render: grocery-flywheel examples/sample_state.json --output dist/dashboard.html
- Import: grocery-flywheel import normalized examples/imports/example-history.json --output state.json

## Maps
- Repo/docs map: README.md (Repo map section)
- Domain glossary: CONTEXT.md
- State contract (all vintages): docs/DATA_MODEL.md
- AI surface: MCP server `grocery-flywheel-mcp` — tools: analyze_replenishment_state,
  render_replenishment_dashboard, summarize_sourcing_research, evaluate_dietary,
  plan_next_cart (JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio, stateless; .mcp.json in repo root).
  Packaged skill: skills/grocery-flywheel/SKILL.md

## Docs
- docs/PRD.md, docs/DECISION_REGISTER.md, docs/WORKFLOW_SPEC.md
- docs/adapters.md (retailer adapters + onboarding + sourcing)
- docs/patterns.md (flywheel patterns + expansion markets)
- docs/design.md (+ docs/design-preview.html)
- docs/DIETARY_RESTRICTIONS_MODULE.md, docs/PRIVACY_SECURITY_BASELINE.md
- docs/OPERATOR_RUNBOOK.md, docs/adr/

## Limits
- No retailer accounts, no checkout, no hosted sync (consent-gated future)
- Safety stance: dietary evaluation fails closed (missing evidence = needs_review)
